verdict.what: a single-storey black-and-white storefront shop with a tiled base
verdict.summary: A clean, readable monochrome storefront with a strong pillar-and-glass rhythm and a checkered base, but the flat slab roof reads as a lid sitting on the box, and a few glass bays and the side walls look thin and unfinished, so it needs one more pass on the roof and the sides before I'd place it.
